hook: Your office suite just left the browser.
hookText: The office suite leaves the browser

beats.say: Nextcloud has shipped a desktop app for Nextcloud Office, powered by Euro-Office, a sovereign office suite developed and governed in Europe.
It is free and open source for Windows, Mac and Linux, with editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs, and it works offline.
It stays compatible with Microsoft Office formats, and connects to Nextcloud Hub so teams can co-edit files in real time.
